season.evidence: Stored Jun-Sep kept. Web search found this Quartz Creek / Curry Gap / Pride Glacier line described in an old alpine-club journal entry and in spring ski reports (April-June snow use); no source gave a month range. Summit logs for the peak overall peak Jul-Aug, all on the other (south) side.

otherTracksConsidered.why: Jul 12: starts at the Blanca Lake / Virgin Lake trailhead and climbs the south ridge; not the Quartz Creek NE line.
Sep 16 'The Ridge': Blanca Lake trailhead, south ridge.
Sep 2 via Virgin Lake, south ridge.
Aug 17 Blanca Lake trailhead, south ridge.
Jun 14 linkup traverse Columbia-Kyes-Monte Cristo: other peaks.

notes: Every harvested track starts at the Blanca Lake trailhead and climbs the south ridge via Virgin Lake (the route filed as Glaciated Scramble, which already has track points). None uses the Quartz Creek / Curry Gap approach, so the Northeast Ridge gets no track. Nothing from those reports belongs to this route.
